en: A black and white historical postcard image showing a large pile of parcels or packages, likely mail or post, with four uniformed men (possibly postal workers or customs officers) standing behind the pile. In the background, there is a body of water and a town with visible buildings and a church spire. At the top, handwritten text provides a date, location, and reference number.
